key_idea: Pure simulation of the stated loop.
sketch: Follow the steps literally with 64-bit integers: add s to v, subtract max(1, v/10), adjust h by comparing v with k, zero v when h hits zero or v<=0, add v to the distance, then decrement s if positive. Once the wind fades v shrinks by at least 1 per step so the loop ends quickly (a few thousand iterations at most). Pitfall: apply the conditions in the given order using the updated v, and the v<k branch only when v>0.
